resources.string: Put your phone down. The motion alarm arms in %1$d s.
Android stopped the protection service. Resume to keep guarding your phone.
Get notified the moment your charger is connected or unplugged.
Sounds a loud alarm if someone picks up or moves your phone.
Clap and the alarm rings. Handy for finding your phone.
Allow notifications so charging alerts can reach you.
Notifications are blocked, so charging alerts can\'t be shown.
Charging alert notifications are turned off for this app.
Alarm notifications are off. You can still stop the alarm from this screen.
Microphone access is needed to hear claps.
Microphone access was denied. Allow it in Settings to use clap detection.
Clap detection is paused because Android restarted protection in the background. Open the app to resume.
The microphone is busy or unavailable. Clap detection will retry when you reopen the app.
This device has no motion sensor.
Keeps the motion sensor awake while armed, which uses a little extra battery.
You won\'t see charging alerts, or the alarm\'s Stop button on the lock screen.
%1$s phones can stop background apps. In Settings, allow Autostart and set Battery saver to “No restrictions” for Anti-Theft.
Anti-Theft uses notifications to tell you when your charger is connected or unplugged, and to let you stop the alarm from the lock screen.
Clap detection listens for a sharp clap. Sound is analysed on your phone in real time and is never recorded, saved or sent anywhere.
Android won\'t ask again. Open Settings and turn on notifications for Anti-Theft.
Android won\'t ask again. Open Settings → Permissions → Microphone and choose “Allow only while using the app”.
Your phone was moved while the motion alarm was on.
A clap was heard while clap detection was on.
Couldn\'t start protection. Open the app again to retry.
This feature isn\'t supported on this device.
Shown while Anti-Theft is guarding your phone.
Shown while the alarm is ringing, with a Stop button.
Your phone was unplugged from the charger.
